integrity: The quotient field, local singularity types, birational contraction, and anticanonical calculation are proved explicitly; the lattice identities are independently replayable with the bundled verifier. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the smooth squarefree two-outer-Galois-point quartic family and the simultaneous order-four scaling. It does not classify all order-four K3 quotients of type \((10,4,8)\).
title: Outer-Galois quartic quotients are sixteen-point grid blow-ups
